text_block_list.text:
On this day, at Yukino Bijin's earnest 
request, we came to a Japanese-style cafe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thanks a bunch for hanging out 
with me today~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I could never walk into such a fancy place 
alone... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Actually, this place serves senbei as 
fancy sweets, so I've been really curious 
about it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
As a rice cracker lover, I just had to try 
'em. Well then, let's take a look at the 
menu—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Are them strawberries on top!? And 
this one's got heaps of chocolate and 
whipped cream too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's not every day I get to come to a 
place like this, so... Alright, I'm taking 
this chance to try everything on the menu!
choice_data_list:
I'll be there for you again, so don't push 
yourself too hard.
Have as much fun as you want.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, haha... I got a little carried 
away...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If you'll join me again, I'd love to savor 
it taking all the time we need!

And so, after promising to visit together 
again, Yukino Bijin enjoyed a sensible 
portion of sweets.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me-sa! I can eat as many 
senbei as you got!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's start with that green 
one... a pistachio? rice cracker!

Afterward, Yukino Bijin went on to 
successfully eat every single variety of 
rice cracker.
